name: Valor-Ascendant

civilization.name: The Ascending Phalanx
civilization.notes: A warrior culture that achieved interstellar travel before destroying themselves in a civil war of ideological purity. Their ruins are built to withstand orbital bombardment and remain largely intact.

geological_features: Fortified mountain ranges with artificial tunneling
Scorched plains bearing the scars of ancient energy weapons
Deep freshwater aquifers beneath armored bedrock
specific_features: Vast fortress-cities carved into mountainsides, still structurally sound
Automated defense turrets that occasionally activate without warning
description: Valor-Ascendant is a terrestrial world of dramatic mountain ranges and wide, scorched plains that bear the unmistakable signature of directed-energy weaponry deployed on a continental scale. The mountains themselves have been hollowed and reinforced, transformed into fortress-cities of staggering engineering ambition.

The atmosphere remains breathable despite the devastation, testament to the environmental engineering capabilities of the world's former inhabitants. A somber gravity pervades the ruins, the weight of courage spent in service of a cause no one survived to remember.

The Ascending Phalanx built a civilization around the ideal of martial perfection, achieving faster-than-light travel before turning their weapons inward during a schism over what constituted true valor. Their cities, built to endure orbital strikes, survived the war that their builders did not.

Salvage operations on Valor-Ascendant are among the most lucrative and dangerous in the sector, as automated defense systems still sporadically activate with lethal intent. The helium-3 reserves alone could fuel a fleet for decades, but every expedition must weigh profit against the very real possibility of waking something the Phalanx built to outlast them.
